biography: Mika Mueller's story began amidst the sun-drenched hills of Algarve, Portugal, far from the roar of engines. Unlike most racers groomed from karting, Mika's initial passion was surfing. His transition to motorsport was almost accidental. At age 12, while tagging along with his father, a mechanic, to a local hill climb event, he was captivated by the raw power and precision. He pestered his father until he built a makeshift kart from spare parts. The early days were marked by spectacular crashes and a steep learning curve, funded entirely by his earnings from summer jobs at a local surf shop. After winning the regional karting championship in 2022, he made the jump to single-seaters in a low-tier formula series as an independent driver. His performances are inconsistent, flashing moments of brilliance mixed with rookie errors, a testament to his limited experience and resources.
drivingStyle: Mika's driving style is raw and instinctive. He's known for his aggressive entries into corners, often pushing the limits of adhesion. He tends to over-drive the car early in races, burning through his tires in the process. While this approach occasionally yields stunning overtakes, it also leads to costly mistakes and inconsistent results. Under pressure, he can either rise to the occasion with unexpected brilliance or crumble spectacularly, reflecting his volatile nature.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Vieira
rivalries.reason: A fellow Portuguese driver, Ricardo and Mika clashed fiercely in the regional karting scene. Ricardo views Mika as an upstart who hasn't earned his place, constantly dismissing his talent.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: Isabelle is the daughter of a famous racing magnate. She accuses Mika of dangerous driving after a near-miss incident during a race. The rivalry is fuelled by constant accusations and counter-accusations in the media.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky bracelet made of surfboard wax before every race.
Refuses to look at the starting grid until the very last minute, claiming it 'jinxes' his start.
Listens to traditional Fado music on repeat in the hour leading up to a race.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about perfection, it's about surviving chaos."
careerHighlight: Winning the Algarve Regional Karting Championship in 2022 against all odds, securing the victory in the final corner of the last race.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of his debut single-seater race due to overconfidence, costing him a potential podium and valuable championship points.
